<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/*
 * This file is part of PHP CS Fixer.
 *
 * (c) Fabien Potencier <fabien@symfony.com>

namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\PhpTag;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\CodeSample;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinition;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Token;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Tokens;

/**
 * @author Ceeram <ceeram@cakephp.org>
 */
final class BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer extends AbstractFixer implements WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag and it is followed by a blank line.',
            [new CodeSample("<?php \$a = 1;\n\$b = 1;\n")]
        );
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * Must run before BlankLinesBeforeNamespaceFixer, NoBlankLinesBeforeNamespaceFixer.
     * Must run after DeclareStrictTypesFixer.
     */
    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return 1;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isMonolithicPhp() && !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
    }

    /**
     * Find the index where a header comment or a blank line after the opening tag must be inserted.
     */
    public function findHeaderCommentInsertionIndex(Tokens $tokens, string $location): int
    {
        $lineEnding = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();
        $firstToken = $tokens[0];
        $openTagIndex = ($firstToken->isArray() && T_INLINE_HTML === $firstToken->getId()) ? 1 : 0;
        $openTagToken = $tokens[$openTagIndex];
        $openTagEndsWithLineEnding = $openTagToken->isArray()
            && str_ends_with($openTagToken->getContent(), $lineEnding);

        $namespaces = $tokens->getNamespaceDeclarations();
        $namespaceFullName = '';
        $namespaceStartIndex = $openTagIndex;
        $namespaceScopeEndIndex = \count($tokens) - 1;
        if ([] !== $namespaces) {
            $namespace = $namespaces[0];
            $namespaceFullName = $namespace->getFullName();
            $namespaceStartIndex = $namespace->getStartIndex();
            $namespaceScopeEndIndex = $namespace->getScopeEndIndex();
        }

        if ('after_open' === $location) {
            $insertionIndex = $openTagIndex + 1;
            if (
                $openTagEndsWithLineEnding
                && '' === $namespaceFullName
                && $namespaceStartIndex === $openTagIndex
            ) {
                $insertionIndex = $namespaceStartIndex + 1;
            }

            return $insertionIndex;
        }

        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($openTagIndex);
        if (null === $index) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $declareToken = $tokens[$index];
        if (!$declareToken->isArray() || T_DECLARE !== $declareToken->getId()) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $next) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }
        $nextToken = $tokens[$next];
        if ($nextToken->isArray() || '(' !== $nextToken->getContent()) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($next);
        if (null === $next) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }
        $nextToken = $tokens[$next];
        if (!$nextToken->isArray() || T_STRING !== $nextToken->getId() || 0 !== strcasecmp($nextToken->getContent(), 'strict_types')) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($next);
        if (null === $next) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }
        $nextToken = $tokens[$next];
        if ($nextToken->isArray() || '=' !== $nextToken->getContent()) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($next);
        if (null === $next) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }
        $nextToken = $tokens[$next];
        if (!$nextToken->isArray() || T_LNUMBER !== $nextToken->getId()) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($next);
        if (null === $next) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }
        $nextToken = $tokens[$next];
        if ($nextToken->isArray() || ')' !== $nextToken->getContent()) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($next);
        if (null === $next) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }
        $nextToken = $tokens[$next];
        if ($nextToken->isArray() || ';' !== $nextToken->getContent()) {
            return $openTagIndex + 1;
        }

        return min($next + 1, $namespaceScopeEndIndex + 1);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $lineEnding = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();

        $newlineFound = false;
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            if (($token->isWhitespace() || $token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) && str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
                $newlineFound = true;

                break;
            }
        }

        // ignore one-line files
        if (!$newlineFound) {
            return;
        }

        $openTagIndex = $this->findHeaderCommentInsertionIndex($tokens, 'after_open') - 1;
        $token = $tokens[$openTagIndex];

        if (!str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
            $tokens[$openTagIndex] = new Token([$token->getId(), rtrim($token->getContent()).$lineEnding]);
        }

        $newLineIndex = $openTagIndex + 1;
        if (isset($tokens[$newLineIndex]) && !str_contains($tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent(), "\n")) {
            if ($tokens[$newLineIndex]->isWhitespace()) {
                $tokens[$newLineIndex] = new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding.$tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent()]);
            } else {
                $tokens->insertAt($newLineIndex, new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding]));
            }
        }
    }
}

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer` (src/Fixer/PhpTag/BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer.php:182): the check `!str_contains($tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent(), "\n")` treated a multi-line doc comment as "already having a newline" and skipped inserting the blank line after `<?php`.

The fix now:
- returns early if the index is out of bounds,
- prepends a line ending only when the next token is whitespace *without* a newline,
- inserts a blank line whenever the next token is not whitespace (e.g. a multi-line comment).

Verified:
- The issue's reproducer now yields the expected output with `--rules=@PSR12`.
- `tests/Fixer/PhpTag` (27 tests, incl. the previously failing case), `tests/Tokenizer`, `tests/RuleSet`, and `tests/Fixer/Basic` all pass with no failures.
